description: CECID contains 27 extreme-climate indices on a 0.1-degree grid over China for 1979–2018. China University of Geosciences and Chinese Academy of Sciences researchers calculated the indices from CMFD and CDAT weather products using the climdex.pcic package. ScienceDB records CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 for free non-commercial reuse; the inspected top-level metadata does not state the delivery format. These fields can support spatial hazard baselines and infrastructure stress-test scenarios. Agreement with other index products is reported for selected measures, but derived indices retain uncertainty from their underlying meteorological inputs. A grid-cell summary does not resolve every local exposure condition or indicate asset damage. No directly related catalogue resource was identified.
